prompt: Build a Range record for an inclusive integer interval: a compact constructor that swaps out-of-order bounds, plus contains, length and overlaps methods.
explanation: A compact constructor -- public Range { ... } with no parameter list -- runs before the record's components are assigned, so reassigning the parameters lo and hi inside it changes what gets stored; that makes it the natural place to normalize (here: swap out-of-order bounds). Because normalization happens at construction, new Range(5, 2) and new Range(2, 5) are equals(). Two inclusive intervals overlap exactly when each one starts at or before the other one ends, giving the two-comparison test in overlaps.
hints: A compact constructor has no parentheses: public Range { if (lo > hi) { ... } }. Assigning to lo/hi there changes what the record stores.
Swapping needs a temporary variable: int tmp = lo; lo = hi; hi = tmp;
Inclusive intervals overlap when lo <= other.hi() && other.lo() <= hi -- <= makes touching endpoints overlap.
